This land is not mine, I rent it, so I will not put too much money into it. I grow my maize with cassava and some melon between the rows, the way my father showed me. I have no school learning, so I follow what works — last season I put small fertilizer and the maize was fair, so I will do the same small way this year. I cannot buy a full bag for this small plot, so I will share one bag with my brother who farms near me, and I will use the chicken droppings from my small poultry to help the soil. No machine water here, I wait for the rain like everybody.
